title: Shocking suspensions, f-bombs and a flurry of flags. What's going on with NFL officiating and what's next?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Shocking suspensions, f-bombs and a flurry of flags. What's going on with NFL officiating and what's next?
sources.description: The league pressed the officiating union for more accountability measures ahead of the new CBA. And the league just suspended two officials a full eight seasons after the last known officiating suspension. Coincidence?
